BETA Close X RS Group plc has purchased 232,000 ordinary shares for cancellation between May 26th and May 29th, 2026, as part of its £100 million share repurchase program. These purchases were conducted on the London Stock Exchange through Barclays Bank plc. Following these transactions, the company's total issued ordinary shares will be 473,638,968, with no shares held in treasury, resulting in a total of 473,638,968 voting rights. Disclaimer* RS Group PLC 01 June 2026 RS Group plc 1 June 2026 Transaction in Own Shares RS Group plc (the "Company") announces that from 26 May 2026 to 29 May 2026, it purchased for cancellation the following number of its ordinary shares of 10 pence each (Ordinary Shares) through Barclays Bank plc, as part of its £100 million share repurchase programme announced on 20 May 2026 (the "Programme"). All Ordinary Shares were purchased from Barclays Bank plc as an "on exchange" transaction subject to the rules of the London Stock Exchange. Following the above purchases and cancellation of these Ordinary Shares, the Company will have 473,638,968 Ordinary Shares in issue, with no shares held in treasury. Therefore, the total number of voting rights in the Company is 473,638,968. This announcement is made in accordance with the requirements of UK Listing Rule 9.6.6.
